summary: Iter6 review for Skiller's 4-part change (per-creator storefront, TTL index on password_reset_tokens, text indexes on users/posts/courses/gigs, search-input testid disambiguation). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter6.py with 19 new pytest cases. Result 19/19 PASS. Full regression across all iterations: 141/141 PASS in 58s. Specifically verified: GET /api/c/admin, /api/c/maya, /api/c/arjun, /api/c/neha all return 200 with the full storefront payload (user/stats/level/badges/courses/gigs/reels/posts/is_following/is_self), Maya has 1 course, 2 gigs, 1+ reels, 2+ posts as specced; /api/c/<missing> returns 404; payload contains NO _id, NO password_hash, NO followers/following arrays — only counts in stats. Confirmed courses[].enrollments is computed and present. /api/search?q=react returns hybrid results across all 4 buckets via $text index path. /api/search?q=re (2-char) returns >0 results via regex fallback (text-search would return empty). /api/search?q=may regex-falls-back to find user 'maya'. /api/auth/forgot-password now writes both expires_at (ISO string) and expires_at_dt (datetime) — verified directly via PyMongo. TTL index 'expires_at_dt_1' present on password_reset_tokens with expireAfterSeconds key. Reset flow end-to-end (forgot → fetch token → reset → re-login with new password) works via the string-based expires_at parsing path. Text indexes confirmed present on users/posts/courses/gigs collections. Regression: /api/auth/login, /me, /posts/feed (list), /posts/reels (all media_type==video), /dashboard/insights (creator-only — has series + totals), /dashboard/crm all 200. Frontend: Logged in as maya@skiller.app/Demo@123 — POST-LOGIN REDIRECT NOW LANDS ON /dashboard (the iter5 frontend bug is FIXED). /c/maya renders data-testid='creator-storefront'; all four storefront tabs (storefront-tab-courses, -gigs, -reels, -posts) visible and clickable; storefront-follow-btn and storefront-share-btn present. /c/this_doesnt_exist_xyz shows storefront-not-found state. /u/maya now exposes data-testid='view-storefront-link' which navigates to /c/maya. Duplicate-testid fix verified: at desktop viewport (1920x1080) AND mobile (390x844), [data-testid='search-input'] count=0 everywhere; 'search-input-mobile' count=1; 'search-input-desktop' count=1 (both exist in DOM but CSS-hidden per breakpoint — that satisfies the 'each appears at most once' criterion). Smoke tested /feed, /reels, /insights, /crm, /dashboard as Maya — all reachable, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/users.py:31-85 creator_storefront — payload is well-shaped and excludes _id/password_hash/followers/following arrays; uses count_documents per course for enrollments which is N+1 (fine for current scale: 1-50 courses per creator). If scale grows, switch to a single $facet/aggregation. Also note: storefront accepts admin role (line 41) which is intentional and matches the test for admin's storefront; document that admins can also have storefronts so it's a feature not a leak.

/app/backend/routers/search.py — _text_then_regex executes two queries when text returns empty; for 4 collections that's up to 8 queries per /api/search call. Acceptable for typeahead but consider parallelizing the four collection lookups via asyncio.gather to halve p95 latency.

/app/backend/routers/auth.py:81-107 forgot_password — writes both expires_at (string) AND expires_at_dt (datetime). Reset path on line 116 still parses the string. This dual-field design is fine for backward compatibility but cleanup of the legacy 'expires_at' string path can be done once all production tokens have rotated (TTL=1h, so within an hour of deploy).

/app/backend/routers/auth.py logger.info('PASSWORD_RESET_LINK ...') still logs the full reset link unconditionally — iter5 carry-over action. Recommend gating behind APP_ENV != 'production'. Not a regression, was already noted in iter4/iter5 reports.

/app/backend/seed.py text_specs — only one text index allowed per collection; existing-conflict path (try/except) keeps old index, which means if someone changes the text spec they must drop the index manually. Add a doctring noting this.

/app/frontend/src/components/SearchBar.jsx — testid is conditioned on `compact` prop. Both desktop and mobile bars are rendered in DOM at all breakpoints (only CSS-hidden), so the unique-testid invariant relies on the prop being passed correctly from each layout consumer. Verified working in this run on both 1920x1080 and 390x844 viewports.
Iter5 frontend bug (creator post-login redirect to /feed instead of /dashboard) is FIXED in this iteration — verified Maya now lands on /dashboard.
